experiment_title: Illumina Genome Analyzer IIx sequencing: GSM1525105: p-KDM3A_HS(+) Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
study_title: Specific phosphorylation of histone demethylase KDM3A determines target gene expression in response to heat shock
description: Illumina Genome Analyzer IIx sequencing: GSM1525105: p-KDM3A_HS(+) Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
cell_type: Acute T Cell Leukemia T lymphocyte
library_construction_protocol: Lysates were clarified from sonicated nuclei and histone-DNA complexes were isolated with KDM3A or p-KDM3A antibody.The sonicated DNA fragments were purified as Input control. The DNA fragments were end-repaired, adenylated,ligated to adaptors and PCR-amplified for 18 cycles. The PCR products corresponding to bp 250-450 were gel-purified, quantified and stored at -80°C until use for sequencing
